## MSADrawOptions.interactionMode property

What a plain drag on the alignment does. In `"pan"` mode, Shift-drag (add) and Cmd/Ctrl-drag (toggle) still select; in `"select"` mode a plain drag replaces the selection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interactionMode?: "pan" | "select";
```

## Default Value

"pan"
